title: Kannada organisations oppose merger of rural schools

ai.summary: Kannada organisations in Belagavi oppose closing rural schools under Karnataka's magnet school model, citing concerns over language preservation and education access.

facts.claim: Kannada organisations in Belagavi have opposed the closure of some rural schools under the Karnataka Public Schools magnet model.
facts.quote: Kannada organisations in Belagavi have opposed the closure of some rural schools under the Karnataka Public Schools magnet model.

facts.claim: The central committee of Kannada organisations will hold various meetings to decide the future course of protest.
facts.quote: The central committee of Kannada organisations will hold various meetings to decide the future course of protest.

facts.claim: The State government is closing down rural schools in the name of merger of schools under the magnet school model.
facts.quote: The State government is closing down rural schools in the name of merger of schools under the magnet school model.

facts.claim: The State government has not cancelled the scheme, despite repeated protests by student organisations.
facts.quote: The State government has not cancelled the scheme, despite repeated protests by student organisations,

facts.claim: We are seriously concerned about the closure of thousands of Kannada-medium schools under the magnet school scheme.
facts.quote: We are seriously concerned about the closure of thousands of Kannada-medium schools under the magnet school scheme.

facts.claim: It has now become imperative to launch an intense struggle against these actions
facts.quote: It has now become imperative to launch an intense struggle against these actions,

facts.claim: We have also appealed to all Kannada organisations to take a serious view of the State government’s move to hand over government schools to private entities under the adoption scheme.
facts.quote: We have also appealed to all Kannada organisations to take a serious view of the State government’s move to hand over government schools to private entities under the adoption scheme.

facts.claim: Public safety and law and order, education, healthcare and job creation are the primary responsibilities of any government.

facts.claim: No government can wash its hands off its responsibilities

facts.claim: The ruling government must consistently formulate initiatives to protect land, water and language of the State and to ensure the upliftment of the lives of the Kannada people
